belief_note: every bus record was scored with a diagnostic belief: update_belief(previous, {measurement: window}, onboard_context, family=event_type) threaded through the symptom records (the nominal record's belief stands alone); onboard_context holds only ONBOARD_CONTEXT_KEYS (megalith.diagnosis.evidence), never an external cue
satellite_id_note: satellite_id is the flight identity published on every record; sim_identity is the simulated asset that produced the series

relations.wheel_bearing_temperature_delta_k: bearing dissipation P = dI x V_bus = 1.8 x 1.5 A x severity x 28 V across ~0.5 K/W gives dT_ss = 40 K x severity, lagged 30 s; severity recovered from the model's load_fraction = 0.25 + 0.75 x severity in the wear arm; zero when the load channel carries an external torque (drag, close approach), which does not heat the bearing

relations.burn_performance_ratio: onboard burn accounting: achieved delta-v (measured thrust integrated over the spacecraft mass from the commanded start for as long as the thrust is continuous) over commanded delta-v (expected thrust over the commanded interval); a valve stuck open keeps the achieved side growing past the commanded end, a clean burn reads 1.0; drag and the spoofed maneuver start no commanded burn; absent before the first burn

relations.absorbed_power_residual_w: onboard energy balance: C x dT/dt + rejected_heat_w - 12 W nominal equipment dissipation - heater readback x 15 W, with C = 300 J/K; zero under radiator degradation, 50 W x severity of extra absorbed heat under storm or RF heating
relations.array_power_residual_fraction: battery charge accounting, array current against the illumination model and the onboard ephemeris: nominal in every arm of this row (no cause touches the power subsystem; sunlit, no predicted occultation)
relations.capacity_fade_fraction: battery charge accounting, array current against the illumination model and the onboard ephemeris: nominal in every arm of this row (no cause touches the power subsystem; sunlit, no predicted occultation)
relations.radiator_rejection_residual_fraction: onboard thermal model: rejected_heat_w / (k_nominal x (T - T_sink)) - 1 with k_nominal = 0.5 W/K and T_sink = 270 K; radiator degradation lowers the effective conductance (-0.9 x severity), extra absorbed heat leaves it at zero
relations.shadow_geometry_predicted: battery charge accounting, array current against the illumination model and the onboard ephemeris: nominal in every arm of this row (no cause touches the power subsystem; sunlit, no predicted occultation)

relations.detector_temperature_delta_k: instrument thermistor against the 289 K set point: solar loading on the focal plane warms it 14 K x lobe during the crossing, in phase with the saturation; aging and dazzling leave it at the set point
relations.sun_angle_deg: angle between the detector boresight and the sun from the onboard ephemeris and attitude: 128 deg with the sun outside the field of regard (aging, dazzling); 128 - 116 sqrt(lobe) during the crossing, 12 deg at the peak

relations.reset_reproduced: active test 60 s after the second reset: the flight software re-runs the sequence that preceded it; a software fault reproduces, an upset or an injected command does not; absent before the test
relations.seu_rate_per_hour: onboard EDAC counter: memory_ecc_count increments over the trailing 300 s x 12 (per hour); one-second memory_table_corruption windows at seeded times during the radiation enhancement tick it once each; it never ticks otherwise
relations.unexpected_command_count: onboard command log: cumulative security:command/* events (unauthorized source, replay) the payload_cyber authenticator raised; zero unless commands are injected
